activities.title: Morning walk in Cubbon Park
activities.description: Start the day with a leisurely stroll through Cubbon Park’s lush greenery, historic statues and walking trails. Free entry.

activities.title: Travel to Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum
activities.description: Short auto‑rickshaw ride (≈4 km, ~4 min). Estimated cost: INR 100 per person.

activities.title: Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum (VITM)
activities.description: Explore interactive science exhibits, a planetarium and a mini‑science park. Entry fee approx. INR 150 per adult.

activities.title: Travel to lunch at a local restaurant (e.g., MTR or Koshy’s)
activities.description: Auto‑rickshaw ride (≈3 km). Estimated cost: INR 100 per person.

activities.title: Lunch – South Indian cuisine
activities.description: Enjoy a set lunch of dosas, idlis, rice, sambar and a beverage at a mid‑range restaurant. Approx. INR 400 per person.

activities.title: Travel to Venkatappa Art Gallery
activities.description: Auto‑rickshaw ride (≈2 km). Estimated cost: INR 100 per person.

activities.title: Venkatappa Art Gallery
activities.description: View a collection of modern Indian paintings, sculptures and temporary exhibitions. Free entry.

activities.title: Travel to Bangalore Palace
activities.description: Auto‑rickshaw or rideshare (≈5 km, ~15 min). Estimated cost: INR 150 per person.

activities.title: Bangalore Palace (grounds & interior tour)
activities.description: Explore the Tudor‑style palace, its gardens and the royal interiors. Entry fee approx. INR 200 per adult.

activities.title: Return to starting point / end of day
activities.description: Final auto‑rickshaw ride back to your accommodation or central location. Estimated cost: INR 150 per person.
